<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A dish as a card: picture, optional badge, category, name, portion/weight, summary, price and an order button.
  No rating. Axes: layout (vertical, horizontal), media (image, none), density, action (button, none). Records
  map from Codex kind `dish`.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { DishLabels } from "./dish-card.types";
  import type { Dish } from "./dish-showcase.types";

  export type DishCardProps = {
    dish: Dish;
    labels: DishLabels;
    layout?: "vertical" | "horizontal";
    media?: "image" | "none";
    prices?: "show" | "hide";
    action?: "button" | "none";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
    onadd?: (id: string) => void;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Badge from "../compose/Badge.svelte";
  import Block from "../compose/Block.svelte";
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Button from "../compose/Button.svelte";
  import CardContent from "../compose/CardContent.svelte";
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import Link from "../compose/Link.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import Title from "../compose/Title.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import { cn, fmtMoney, urlOf } from "../utils";

  let {
    dish,
    labels,
    layout = "vertical",
    media = "image",
    prices = "show",
    action = "button",
    density = "default",
    onadd,
  }: DishCardProps = $props();
</script>

<Block
  tag="article"
  class={cn(
    "flex flex-col gap-8 bg-card p-6 text-card-foreground inset-ring inset-ring-border rounded",
    "h-full gap-4 overflow-hidden",
    (((layout as string) === "horizontal") ? "flex flex-col sm:flex-row" : "flex flex-col")
  )}
  data-slot="card"
  data-layout={layout}
>
  {#if ((media as string) === "image")}
    <Box class={cn("relative shrink-0", (((layout as string) === "horizontal") ? "sm:w-48" : ""))}>
      <MediaFrame alt={dish.name} ratio="4/3" class="h-full" />
      {#if dish.badge}
        <Badge variant="default" size="default" class="absolute left-4 top-4">
          {dish.badge}
        </Badge>
      {/if}
    </Box>
  {/if}
  <CardContent class="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-2">
    <Group gap="2" align="center" class="flex-wrap">
      <Text size="xs" class="uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground" data-slot="category">
        {dish.tag}
      </Text>
      {#if ((media as string) === "none")}
        {#if dish.badge}
          <Badge variant="secondary" size="sm">
            {dish.badge}
          </Badge>
        {/if}
      {/if}
    </Group>
    <Title as={3} size="base" weight="bold">
      {#if dish.href}
        <Link href={urlOf(dish.href)} variant="default" data-slot="open">
          {dish.name}
        </Link>
      {:else}
        {dish.name}
      {/if}
    </Title>
    {#if dish.weight}
      <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground" data-slot="portion">
        {dish.weight}
      </Text>
    {/if}
    {#if ((density as string) === "default")}
      <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
        {dish.summary}
      </Text>
    {/if}
    <Group gap="4" justify="between" class="mt-auto pt-2">
      {#if ((prices as string) === "show")}
        <Text size="xl" weight="bold" data-slot="price">
          {fmtMoney(dish.price, dish.currency)}
        </Text>
      {/if}
      {#if ((action as string) === "button")}
        <Button variant="default" size="sm" type="button" onclick={() => onadd?.(dish.id)}>
          {labels.add}
        </Button>
      {/if}
    </Group>
  </CardContent>
</Block>
